Q066-01.notes: Sun slope 1.5 m rise per 1 m run; over 10 m horizontal the ray drops 15 m, plus 2 m on wall: h=15+2=17.

Q066-03.notes: tanA=a/b, tanB=b/a, so a^2=4b^2, a=2b; 5b^2=85, b^2=17; area=ab/2=b^2=17. A 10, C 20 do not follow; D 21.25=85/4 (hypotenuse^2/4) wrong.

Q066-13.notes: (2,8): 8<=2a+3 -> a>=2.5; not (6,21): 21>6a+3 -> a<3. Only 2.8 works. A 2.2 fails first; C 3.0 gives 21<=21 so point is included (boundary trap); D 3.4 includes point.

Q066-14.notes: 2.5w+2(2w)=6.5w<=108 -> w<=16.6 -> 16. C 17 rounds up (6.5*17=110.5>108); A 11 and D 24 from mis-set inequalities.

Q066-17.notes: Revenue=4(50-L)+9L=200+5L; 300<=200+5L<=360 -> 20<=L<=32 -> 13 values. B 12 off-by-one; A 11; D 32 upper bound.

Q066-18.notes: p=24b so 0.25p=6b: 12c+6b=480. A uses b as p; B misplaces 24; D divides instead of multiplies.
